title: Web client — taking a turn
about: A choice is taken from the keyboard. Written against selectors both the pre-T63 page and the T63 page have, so the same script is evidence before and after. What must hold: the choice button's name carries its cost in words; after Enter, focus is on the NEW scene's heading (the button pressed no longer exists) and Orca speaks one ordered digest ending in the choice count; the scene can then be walked by heading.

steps.label: Tab to the second choice
expect: Travel to Collapsed Overpass, 2 hours push button

steps.label: Enter takes it
forbid: What you hear What you hear
steps.note: The scene section was a region named by its own heading in the first T63 build, and Orca then spoke the day, time and place twice on every turn ('region Day 1 …' then the heading); it is no longer a named region.

steps.label: Orca H
expect: What do you do? heading level 2
